claims.text: `reciprocal_rank_fusion` fuses ranked id lists using the constant `RRF_K`
`split_text` splits text on paragraph boundaries and keeps an overlap between chunks
`VectorStore.search_vectors` queries Qdrant and returns chunk id and score pairs
`ingest_document` is a worker task that calls `IngestionService`
`answer_query` retrieves chunks with `HybridRetriever` and then calls `LLMClient`
`RedisAnswerCache` stores answers under `answer_cache_key` before the retriever runs
`split_text` is called by the ingestion service
Lexical and dense search are kept independent so either can degrade alone
